sources.title: Ticket T-007 — Day 14: gate must syntax-check ticket change scripts

decisions.notice: A syntax error in any tickets/changes/*.mjs file now fails npm run verify; the failure names the file. Verified locally 24 Nov: a deliberately broken script fails node --check (exit 1) while all 6 real change scripts pass.
decisions.text: collectJsFiles() includes tickets/changes/*.mjs in the gate's syntax checks
decisions.why: Ticket T-007: the gate claimed to syntax-check every source file but never checked ticket change scripts — executable code the factory runs on every ticket. The fix closes exactly that hole; before T-007 there was no collectJsFiles() at all and the gate looped only over src/ + scripts/.
decisions.plan: npm run verify syntax-checks ticket change scripts (tickets/changes/*.mjs) — a syntax error there fails the gate

decisions.notice: Qodo flagged this as Medium behavioral complexity: if any supported invocation fails to distinguish import from direct execution, the gate can be skipped while appearing successful. Local check 24 Nov: import returns the file list without running the gate; node scripts/verify.mjs, absolute-path invocation from /tmp, and npm run verify all run the gate (exit 0). The flagged failure mode does not reproduce under any supported invocation.
decisions.text: The gate runner only runs on direct execution (process.argv[1] === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) so tests can import collectJsFiles() without starting verification
decisions.why: Ticket T-007 acceptance requires the collector to be testable via an exported collectJsFiles(); importing the module must not execute the gate. The exact-identity comparison is the mechanism Qodo's review questioned.
decisions.plan: scripts/verify.mjs exports collectJsFiles() and the gate runner only runs when the file is executed directly

story.lede: The gate claimed to check every source file but skipped the executable scripts the factory runs on every ticket; now it checks them.

paragraphs.label: Today
paragraphs.text: npm run verify syntax-checks src/ and scripts/ only. A syntax error in tickets/changes/*.mjs escapes the gate and is caught only when the factory tries to run the script.

paragraphs.label: Why
paragraphs.text: Change scripts are executable code the factory runs on every ticket; a broken one failing late wastes a factory run and can leave a ticket half-applied.

paragraphs.label: What
paragraphs.text: collectJsFiles() now includes tickets/changes/ (26 files gated, all 6 change scripts), is exported for tests, and the gate runner only executes on direct invocation.

paragraphs.label: How
paragraphs.text: One exported collector plus an exact-identity import/execution guard; two coverage tests lock the new file list in.

story.title: Close the gate hole for ticket change scripts
